# Cuprice MCP Server

> Manage Cuprice pricing projects from AI tools via Model Context Protocol.

Endpoint: POST https://mcp.cuprice.io/mcp
Docs: https://docs.cuprice.io/mcp
Website: https://cuprice.io

## Tools

- [list-projects](https://docs.cuprice.io/mcp#available-tools): List all pricing projects
- [get-project](https://docs.cuprice.io/mcp#available-tools): Get full project details (plans, features, theme)
- [get-shared-project](https://docs.cuprice.io/api-reference/share): Get public pricing data by Share ID
- [create-project](https://docs.cuprice.io/mcp#available-tools): Create a new project
- [update-project](https://docs.cuprice.io/mcp#available-tools): Update project settings
- [add-feature](https://docs.cuprice.io/mcp#available-tools): Add a feature to a project's backlog
- [create-plan](https://docs.cuprice.io/mcp#available-tools): Create a pricing plan
- [add-feature-to-plan](https://docs.cuprice.io/mcp#available-tools): Add a feature to a plan
- [publish-project](https://docs.cuprice.io/mcp#available-tools): Publish a project to get a Share ID
- [get-embed-code](https://docs.cuprice.io/mcp#available-tools): Get embed snippet (HTML/Next.js/React)
- [get-receipt](https://docs.cuprice.io/api-reference/receipt): Get Stripe purchase details
